gloss: body composition analyzer; body composition scale

definitions.gloss: body composition analyzer; body composition scale
definitions.explanation: A device that measures body composition — including body fat percentage, muscle mass, bone density, and water content — in addition to weight. More advanced than a standard scale ({体重計|たいじゅうけい}).

examples.japanese: {体組成計|たいそせいけい}で{体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ}を{測|はか}った。
examples.english: I measured my body fat percentage with the body composition analyzer.

examples.japanese: {体組成計|たいそせいけい}では{体重|たいじゅう}だけでなく{筋肉量|きんにくりょう}も{確認|かくにん}できる。
examples.english: With a body composition analyzer, you can check not just weight but also muscle mass.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}の{体組成計|たいそせいけい}はスマートフォンと{連携|れんけい}してデータを{管理|かんり}できるものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many of the latest body composition analyzers can sync with smartphones to manage data.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体組成計|たいそせいけい}で{測|はか}る: to measure with a body composition analyzer
- {体組成計|たいそせいけい}の{数値|すうち}: readings from a body composition analyzer
- {家庭用|かていよう}{体組成計|たいそせいけい}: home-use body composition analyzer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {体重計|たいじゅうけい}: bathroom scale — measures weight only
- ヘルスメーター: health meter — marketing term for a scale; may or may not include composition analysis
